description:
Free discovery: which x402 facilitators a payer has settled through, and how many.

    unique_facilitators = 1 is a thin/captive agent (locked to one rail); breadth
    across facilitators indicates a more established cross-rail agent. Returns the
    facilitator_ids list plus tx/merchant context. Fail-open: a DB gap returns
    data_available=false rather than erroring.

wallet.description: Solana wallet public key (32-44 base58 chars) to look up its x402 facilitator footprint.
wallet.title: Wallet

name: get_facilitator_footprint

data_available.description: False when the corpus/DB was unavailable.
data_available.title: Data Available

error.description: Present only on the degraded path.
error.title: Error

facilitator_ids.description: The facilitator identifiers observed for this payer.
facilitator_ids.title: Facilitator Ids

first_seen.description: ISO timestamp of first observed activity.
first_seen.title: First Seen

found.description: True if the wallet has observed corpus activity.
found.title: Found

last_seen.description: ISO timestamp of last observed activity.
last_seen.title: Last Seen

unique_facilitators.description: Distinct x402 facilitators this payer has settled through (1 = thin/captive).
unique_facilitators.title: Unique Facilitators
